Indian Standard (Reaffirmed 2002) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
WOODRUFF KEYS AND KEYWAYS 

(Second Revision ) 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and general requirements of woodruff keys and keyways. 

1-1 It also gives the relationship to be observed between the diameter of the shaft and the section of 
the key for both torque transmission and positional applications. 

2. Dimensions and Tolerances 

2.1 Keys — See Table 1 . 

2.2 Keyways — See Table 2. 

3. Material — Steel of tensile strength not less than 590 MPa in the finished condition. 

4. Relationship of Shaft Diameter to Key Size — Two series of relationships between shaft 
diameter and key size are given in Table 3 — Series 1 for torque applications and Serres 2 for positional 
applications (for example, where, as in the case of an interference fit, the torque is not transmitted 
through the key but through the shaft/hub interface). 

5. Designation — Shall be designated by its width and its height followed by the number of this 
standard. 

Example : A woodruff key of width 4 mm and height 6*5 mm shall be designated as: 

'Woodruff Key 4X65 IS : 2294' 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1963- The first revision was issued in 1980 to bring it in 
line with ISO 3912-1977 'Woodruff keys and keyways' published by the International Organization for 
Standardization (ISO). 

The second revision has been brought out to improve shape of key given in Table 1, incorporate 
surface finish in it and to rectify the ruling defects in Table 1 and Table 2. 

Whitney keys and keyways are not included and this form shall be adopted by agreement between 
the supplier and the purchaser. 



Adopted 14 August 1986 



April 1987, BIS 



Gr 2

AMENDMENT NO. 1 JANUARY 1993 

TO 

IS 2294 : 1986 SPECIFICATION FOR WOODRUFF 

KEYS AND KEYWAYS 

( Second Revision ) 

( Page 2, Fig: in Table 1 and Table 1, col 4) — Substitute 'A' for 'hi*. 

( Page 3, Fig, in Table 2 and Table 2, coll) — Substitute x h' for l h\\ 

( Page 3, Table 2, col 2 ) — Substitute *b Nom' for" b Non\ 

(Page 3, Table 2, col 3 and 4) — Substitute 'Light Driving FiV for 'Normal 



( Page 3, Table 2, col 3 and 5 ) — Substitute 'N9' for 'n9' and *P9' /or *p9' 
respectively. 

(Page 4, Table 3 Jast col) — Substitute 'bx h xD'for'b x hi xD\
